name: quick-start
description: Expose a local URL with a temporary trycloudflare.com tunnel. The tunnel remains active until cf exits.

arguments.name: url
arguments.description: Local URL to expose (for example, http://localhost:3000)

options.name: allowed-mail
options.description: Require email authentication (cloudflared 2026.9.2 or later). Accepts an exact address or domain wildcard such as user@example.com or *@example.org. May be repeated or comma-separated.
